subject: Sprint zero: K8s handoff, ops playbook & evidence request
messages:
From: Carlos Mendez <carlos@novamed.com>
To: jasmine_liu <jasmine_liu@redwood.com>, irene_choi <irene_choi@redwood.com>
Cc: Elena Rios <elena.rios@novamed.com>
Date: 2027-04-11 09:12 AM -0700
Subject: Sprint zero: kickoff and compliance evidence request

Hi Jasmine / Irene,

Thanks for the pre-call earlier. We want to lock in a Sprint‑Zero kickoff for our private deployment (on‑prem, VPC‑adjacent) and capture a short ops playbook plus the compliance evidence our security team requires. For the kickoff agenda can you confirm the following:

- Network diagram (north/south egress, internal VPC, routing/BGP points)
- Node pool topology (cpu vs infra vs gpu, expected instance profiles)
- Persistent storage plan (CSI, PV class mapping, snapshot/backup cadence)
- KMS integration and key rotation notes (we use AWS KMS in our VPC but on‑prem HSM is possible)
- Audit log retention and sample logs we can review for SOC2
- Expected installation timeline (sprint zero -> staging -> prod)

If you can send an initial mutual action plan and any evidence bundles (SOC2-related artifacts) ahead of the meeting, that would speed review on our side. We aim to start the onsite/network handshake week of Apr 26 if that works.

Thanks,
Carlos
VP, Infrastructure — Novamed
[Attachment: request_summary.xlsx (spreadsheet)]

From: jasmine_liu <jasmine_liu@redwood.com>
To: Carlos Mendez <carlos@novamed.com>
Cc: neha_kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.com>, marissa_cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, irene_choi <irene_choi@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-04-11 11:04 AM -07:00
Subject: Re: Sprint zero: kickoff and compliance evidence request

Carlos — thanks for the clear list.

We can definitely deliver the items you listed. I'm attaching an initial Mutual Action Plan (MAP) and a lightweight ops playbook draft so your team can scan before the call. High‑level answers to your bullets below:

- Network diagram: will attach V1 showing VPC peering points, egress NAT paths, and VLAN segmentation.
- Node pools: recommend three pools (infra, general purpose, inference GPU). We’ll include sizing guidance and QoS constraints per pool in the playbook.
- Storage: CSI with two storage classes (fast nvme block for ephemeral inference; replicated block for stateful). Snapshots via Velero for backups; retention defaults 30 days (configurable).
- KMS: we support AWS KMS cross‑account envelope encryption, and can provide guidance for HSM-backed key usage.
- Audit logs: we’ll supply sample syslog/audit events and our recommended CloudWatch/ELK ingestion pattern for retention.
- Timeline: Sprint‑Zero (2 weeks), Staging (3 weeks), Prod cutover window (1–2 days).

Action items from our side:
1) Share MAP + ops playbook (attached).
2) Share network_diagram_v1.pdf by EOD tomorrow.
3) Neha will assemble the SOC2 evidence pack and list redactions required for public delivery.

Can your site ops lead confirm an on‑site window Apr 26–28 for the physical network handshake? If yes we'll reserve engineer time.

Best,
Jasmine Liu
Solutions Engineer — Redwood Inference
[Attachment: mutual-action-plan-novamed.xlsx (spreadsheet)]

From: neha_kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.com>
To: jasmine_liu <jasmine_liu@redwood.com>, marissa_cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, irene_choi <irene_choi@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-04-12 08:37 AM -07:00
Subject: Internal: Sprint‑Zero checklist and SOC2 evidence plan (Novamed)

Team — quick internal checklist / acceptance criteria to use for the call and the MAP. I'll compile the evidence bundle after we align: please add any gaps.

Acceptance criteria (deploy readiness):
- Cluster sizing: min 3 control-plane nodes (HA), worker pools: infra (2 r5.large equiv), compute (autoscaling), inference (gpu: 2 x A10 / equivalent)
- Node pools: taints/tolerations for infra pods, dedicated CSI nodes for block operations; explicit kubelet eviction thresholds
- Storage: CSI driver configured with two storage classes (fast-ssd / standard-block); PV reclaim policy: Retain for stateful; dynamic provisioning in place; snapshot schedule and S3/remote archive for long term
- Networking: explicit BGP peering termination points; egress NAT gateway in VPC; CIDR allowlist for Redwood control-plane callbacks; MTU and CNI considerations noted
- Secrets/KMS: envelope encryption using customer's AWS KMS key; include KMS key alias, IAM role mapping, and rotation window (90 days)
- Logging & audit: AuditPolicy.yaml sample, forwarded audit logs for 365 days retention to customer log store; sample syslog lines included in evidence pack
- Access: OIDC for RBAC with SCIM/provisioning guide; service accounts limited with least privilege; account breakglass procedures documented
- Compliance artifacts: architecture diagram, change logs, KMS binding docs, sample audit logs (redacted), penetration test summary, backup snapshots manifest

Gaps we need from Novamed: BGP ASN for peering; NAT egress IP pool; site contact for VLAN tagging and switch access window; preferred day/time for on‑site cable handoff.

I'll assemble soc2-evidence-pack.zip with placeholders and redaction notes. Marissa — can you confirm backup snapshot manifest format so I can include realistic sample manifests?

-Neha

From: jasmine_liu <jasmine_liu@redwood.com>
